Brand 'KYOCERA' and model 'ECOSYS P3045dn' are clearly printed on the front panel in photo 1.
The printer is sitting on a wooden table with a curtain and tiled wall in the background.
A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI IFEOLUWA' is visible across both photos.
The power button and an 'A4' label are visible on the right-hand side of the unit.
